title: bug: the docs say .serena/project.yml ignored_memory_patterns hides _archive/ memories, but .serena/ is gitignored and no Moe code writes that entry, so in every other Moe project QA-archived handoffs stay in list_memories and read_memory serves them (UnAI: 66 of 129 names)
description:
Filed by hunt #19 (task-443e8eac), lane 2: Serena integration. HEAD 3cd256eb.

PROBLEM
- docs/skills/moe-planning/SKILL.md:83 and docs/MEMORY.md:80 say archived memories are hidden by `.serena/project.yml` `ignored_memory_patterns: [_archive/.*]`.
- .serena/ is gitignored (.gitignore:54 `/.serena/`), so that entry exists only in this checkout's untracked project.yml, added by hand during task-78ba155c.
- `git grep -n ignored_memory_patterns 3cd256eb` hits only those two docs and the generated mirror (packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/skillFiles.ts:1354). No script, launcher or daemon writes the entry, and Serena's template default is [].
- So in any other project, the archive move that qa.md:23 prescribes leaves every retired handoff in list_memories, and read_memory serves it.

EVIDENCE (/mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-443e8eac/A/)
- On this host:
  - UnAI, algorun, moe-next, px4swarm and sentinal all have `ignored_memory_patterns: []`.
  - UnAI's qa.md carries the archive rule, and its _archive/ holds 66 files.
- A1-archive-visibility-repro.sh runs Serena 1.6.2's own MemoryManager on copies of the stores (A1-archive-visibility-out.txt):
  UnAI: list_memories: 129 names, 66 of them under _archive/ ... read_memory('_archive/task-353db3dc...-handoff') -> SERVED
  moes: list_memories: 1053 names, 0 of them under _archive/ ... read_memory('_archive/...') -> REFUSED

FIX DIRECTION
- scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs already keeps a Moe-managed block in .serena/project.local.yml on every launch. Have that block also carry ignored_memory_patterns: project.yml's own list plus "_archive/.*".
  - It must merge the two, because a key in project.local.yml replaces the project.yml key.
  - Read project.yml's list with a parser like parseIgnoredPaths. If that list cannot be read safely, emit no memory key.
- A user's own ignored_memory_patterns in project.local.yml, outside the block, is the opt-out for that key. The block must then not emit it, because a duplicate YAML key can stop Serena loading the project.
- Docs:
  - MEMORY.md:80: name the launcher block as the source of the hiding, and replace "read_file still reads the raw file" with the host's own reader (Read or cat). Serena's read_file refuses .serena/ here, because the block's ignored_paths carries .serena.
  - MEMORY.md:139-143: list the new key and its opt-out.

FILES: scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs, scripts/tests/serena-ignore.test.mjs, docs/MEMORY.md (:80 and :139-143 only).

PLACEMENT: shares docs/MEMORY.md with task-c1162cba (this hunt's dead-mem-pointer row). That row owns MEMORY.md:86 and moe-planning SKILL.md:82-83; this row leaves SKILL.md:83 to it. There is no dependsOn.
definitionOfDone: A serena-ignore.test.mjs row: a project.yml with `ignored_memory_patterns: []` gets a managed block that carries _archive/.*, and a project.yml list [x] gets [x, _archive/.*]. A YAML parse of the written project.local.yml, or Serena's own MemoryManager, shows the merged list.

A serena-ignore.test.mjs row: a user's own ignored_memory_patterns outside the block is left byte-identical, and the block then emits no such key (the file parses with no duplicate key). An unreadable project.yml list emits no memory key.
`node --test scripts/tests/serena-ignore.test.mjs` passes, and `grep -c 'read_file` still reads' docs/MEMORY.md` prints 0.

implementationPlan.description:
IMPLEMENT (DoD 1 and 2) in scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs, with the session's own editing tool.

Serena 1.6.2 applies project.local.yml with a whole-key replace: `yaml_data.update(local_yaml_data)` in serena/config/serena_config.py:713-725, under ~/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent. So the block must carry project.yml's own list plus '_archive/.*'.

1. Generalise the parser: `export function parseStringSequence(text, key)`.
   - Build a KEY regex from the key: unquoted, double-quoted or single-quoted, then ':' (the current KEY at :65).
   - Reuse scalar/flowSequence/blockSequence unchanged.
   - Keep `export function parseIgnoredPaths(text) { return parseStringSequence(text, 'ignored_paths'); }`.
2. `renderBlock(patterns, memoryPatterns = null)`: when memoryPatterns is an array, append 'ignored_memory_patterns:' and its items after the ignored_paths items, through the same JSON-quote and escape mapping as the ignored_paths items (factor out one item-renderer). With the default null, the output is byte-identical to today's except for the WHY lines.
3. WHY and header comments (:1-13, :23-28): say the block also hides QA-archived memories (_archive/.*), and that setting ignored_memory_patterns yourself outside the block keeps your list. With that key, Moe leaves it out of the block instead of removing the block. Suggested extra lines:
   '# Moe also hides QA-archived memories (_archive/.*); set ignored_memory_patterns yourself outside'
   '# this block to keep your own list instead.'
4. In main(): read project.yml once and give the text to collect, so both keys come from one read. Then compute the memory list:
   - null when any line of local.user matches /^(["']?)ignored_memory_patterns\1[ \t]*:(?:[ \t]|$)/. That is the user's own key; emitting a second one would be a duplicate YAML key, and Serena's loader can refuse the project.
   - null when parseStringSequence(yml, 'ignored_memory_patterns') returns null. Error handling: a list that cannot be read safely is never guessed at, and the block is still written for ignored_paths.
   - otherwise the parsed list, plus '_archive/.*' appended when it is absent.
   Pass the result to renderBlock.
   Do NOT add ignored_memory_patterns to OWN_KEY (:140): a user's memory key must not remove the block.
   checkUser, the skip and remove paths, the 'is up to date' byte comparison and the one-line output contract stay unchanged. The [OK] line's count is still the ignored_paths count.
5. The module still imports only node: builtins (F7).

Run the step-1 file: every row passes.

DOCS in docs/MEMORY.md (DoD 3's grep), with the session's own editing tool: Edit on a Claude seat, apply_patch on a codex exec seat. Never use Serena (it ignores docs/) or a shell write. Touch only these lines, because task-c1162cba owns :86.

The phrase "read_file` still reads" must be gone. Keep the rest of :80 (the archive command and the coreutils note) byte-identical.

Say the block also carries `ignored_memory_patterns` (project.yml's own list plus `_archive/.*`, because a project.local.yml key replaces project.yml's), and that setting `ignored_memory_patterns` yourself outside the block keeps yours: the block then omits that key and is not removed.

It must exit 0. The scripts/tests harnesses may run in place; this one builds its fixtures under os.tmpdir() and strips MOE_* and GIT_* from each row's env. ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, once, as the final step. Load adversarial-self-review. Read the diff as a user whose project.local.yml or project.yml is unusual:

- Are docs/MEMORY.md:86 and moe-planning SKILL.md untouched? task-c1162cba owns them.
If anything changes, re-run the step-4 command and use that fresh output for complete_task.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: Every launch that runs scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs writes a managed .serena/project.local.yml block that also carries ignored_memory_patterns. The list is project.yml's own, with '_archive/.*' appended when missing, so QA-archived memories stay hidden from Serena's list_memories, read_memory and write_memory in every Moe project, not only in a checkout whose untracked project.yml was edited by hand. The block leaves that key out when the user sets ignored_memory_patterns outside the block, or when project.yml's list cannot be read safely. docs/MEMORY.md names the block as the source and stops saying that read_file still reads archived files.
acceptanceCriteria: A project.yml with ignored_memory_patterns [] gives a block whose ignored_memory_patterns is ['_archive/.*']. A list [x] gives [x, '_archive/.*']. A list already holding '_archive/.*' holds it once.
A user's own ignored_memory_patterns outside the block stays byte-identical; the block is still written, without that key, and the file has exactly one such key.
An unreadable project.yml memory list gives a block with no memory key; ignored_paths is still written.
docs/MEMORY.md no longer says 'read_file` still reads', and names the launcher block as the source of the hiding.
invariants: The script still exits 0 and prints exactly one line on every path, and imports only node: builtins.
A user ignored_memory_patterns key never removes the block; only MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_OVERRIDE=0, a user ignore_all_files_in_gitignore and a user ignored_paths do (OWN_KEY unchanged).
parseIgnoredPaths keeps its exact behaviour (U3 rows unchanged).
No duplicate YAML key is ever written.
docs/MEMORY.md:86 and docs/skills/moe-planning/SKILL.md are untouched (task-c1162cba owns them).
compatibility: An existing managed block is rewritten once with the new key and WHY lines, then reported up to date.
Serena's merge is a whole-key replace (serena_config.py:713-725), so project.yml's own memory patterns are kept by merging them into the block.
Both IDE bundles already ship scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs (F7); no bundle manifest change.
approvedScope: scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs: the exported parseStringSequence(text, key), parseIgnoredPaths delegating to it, renderBlock(patterns, memoryPatterns = null), the memory-list computation in main(), and the WHY and header comments.
scripts/tests/serena-ignore.test.mjs: the EXPECTED literal and new U5, F8 and F9 rows.
docs/MEMORY.md: the :80 hiding and read_file sentence, and :139-143.
reuse: The existing scalar, flowSequence and blockSequence YAML-subset parser (moe-serena-ignore.mjs:67-114) and renderBlock's JSON-quote escaping (:128-132).
The F-row fixture(), run() and read() helpers in serena-ignore.test.mjs.
sourceAssumptions: At 3cd256eb, git grep finds ignored_memory_patterns only in docs/MEMORY.md:80, docs/skills/moe-planning/SKILL.md:83 and generated skillFiles.ts:1354; no code writes it.
.gitignore:54 ignores /.serena/, so project.yml is untracked, and every other Moe project on this host (UnAI, algorun, moe-next, px4swarm, sentinal) has ignored_memory_patterns: [].
Serena 1.6.2's ProjectConfig reads ignored_memory_patterns from the merged dict (serena_config.py:644), and project.local.yml keys replace project.yml keys (:713-725).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1) Write ignored_memory_patterns into .serena/project.yml at launch. Rejected: project.yml is Serena's own file, which it re-saves, and the script deliberately never touches it.
2) Have the daemon's init write it. Rejected: .serena/ is created by Serena, not by Moe, and existing projects would never get it.
3) Chosen: extend the block the launchers already manage in project.local.yml. It reaches every project that runs Serena under Moe, keeps the user's opt-out, and stays inside one tested script.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- Hunt #19 evidence is in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-443e8eac/A/: A1-archive-visibility-repro.sh runs Serena's MemoryManager on store copies. In UnAI, 66 of 129 names are archived and served.
- scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs already reads project.yml's ignored_paths with a YAML-subset parser that refuses anything ambiguous (aliases, tags, booleans, bad escapes). That parser generalises to any key.
- checkUser's OWN_KEY drives the remove-the-block opt-out. The memory key needs its own, softer opt-out (omit the key, keep the block).
planningNotes.risks:
- A user key that the step-2 regex misses would produce a duplicate key. Cover quoted keys, and keep the check on local.user (the text outside the block).
- Memory patterns are Python regexes: '|', '^' or '(' cannot be plain YAML scalars. parseStringSequence refuses an unquoted one, which then means no memory key.
- Changing the WHY lines rewrites every seat's block once; that is intended.
- task-c1162cba edits docs/MEMORY.md:86 at the same time. Keep to :80 and :139-143.
